title: "Sprott E System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& yz \\
\dot{y} &=& -x^2-y \\
\dot{z} &=& 1+ax
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=6$ and initial condition $(1,-2,-2)$.
